Vegetation__AppConfig__Meta.Meta__Description: The vegetation system's defaults. A project's Vegetation__SceneData is born with a full copy of these, and from then on the project's own values win. Plants are never loaded on a project that is not enabled, so nor is this file.
Vegetation__AppConfig__Meta.Meta__WhySameKeys: The keys of Vegetation__LineRules__Config, Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Config, Vegetation__LinearToolDefaults__Config and Vegetation__BrushDefaults__Config are exactly the keys in a project's record, so a default is one grep from where it is saved. Adam, 04-Nov-2026: "save all parameters to a new json object with nested keys eetc in my style per file that we enable the vegeation on".

Vegetation__SceneData__Config.Vegetation__SceneData__Description: What a project's object starts with. ShowByDefault and DefaultTransparencyPercent are where a viewer starts on a device that has not chosen.
Vegetation__SceneData__Config.Vegetation__SceneData__EnabledByDefaultN: On for every project unless an admin has unticked it in Dev Tools (Adam, 05-Nov-2026: 'make the admin ticked on boxes on by default now ... keep those gates so i can disable though'). Only a saved Enabled false turns a project off.

Vegetation__LineRules__Config.Vegetation__LineRules__Description: The Vegetation Linework panel's sliders. Weights are screen pixels, as RenderConfig__Linework__LineWidth is. Each Factor scales the asset's own number: 1.00 leaves the asset as written.

Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Descripti: The panel's Advanced dropdown. The Lod values are the screen radius in pixels below which a ball stops drawing that detail, so a far bush is a clean outline and not a smudge.
Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__FillWallS: A plant's fill against the model's walls: 1.00 is exactly the brightness of a wall facing the camera, worked out from the scene's lights for each view, so it changes as you move. Adam, 04-Nov-2026: "It should be the same brightness as the building walls and change as you move". Under 1 is darker than the walls.
Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__FillToneN: The fill on a sheet, where a plant lies on paper and has no walls to match.
Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Vegetation__LineRulesAdvanced__DepthBias: Log depth, as RenderConfig__Linework__DepthBias, but a fifth of it.The model's 0.00015 is about 15 cm at 150 m, which let one bush's lines show through the fill of the bush in front of it on a long lens.

Vegetation__LinearToolDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Path__Description: What a new path starts from in the Linear Tool. A path saves these rules and a seed, never its plants.
Vegetation__LinearToolDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Path__PlantScaleNote: The whole plant, on top of each palette item's own: 0.5 is half the size in every way, with no plant redrawn differently. Adam, 04-Nov-2026: "I would set a scale of 0.5".
Vegetation__LinearToolDefaults__Config.Vegetation__PathAdvanced__DepthAcrossMmN: 0 keeps each asset's own depth. Anything else fits every plant to a bed of that width, and keeps its long side along the path.
Vegetation__LinearToolDefaults__Config.Vegetation__PathAdvanced__HeightFitMmNot: 0 keeps each asset's own height. Anything else fits every plant to that height, and a clipped hedge to its exact line.

Vegetation__BrushDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Brush__Description: What the Bush Tool starts from. A brushed plant is saved as itself, because it depends on the surface under the pointer at that moment.
Vegetation__BrushDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Brush__PlantScaleNote: The whole plant, on top of each palette item's own. The panel moves Density and MinSpacingMm with it, so half size is the same bed, smaller.
Vegetation__BrushDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Brush__SameHeightMmNote: With SameHeightOnly a stroke stays on the surface it started on, so brushing a planter leaves the ground beside it alone.

Vegetation__PlaceDefaults__Config.Vegetation__Place__Description: The asset browser, when a card drops a single plant.

Vegetation__Transparency__Config.Vegetation__Transparency__Description: The Transparency slider. At 0 nothing changes: the same opaque route as if it did not exist.
Vegetation__Transparency__Config.Vegetation__Transparency__SeeThroughFrom: From here a plant stops masking the profile lines of what is behind it, so the wall's edges show through.

Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__Description: What may be redrawn while the camera moves on a live frame. Every other render, and the frame after the camera stops, draws everything, whatever these say.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__MovingMsNote: Time per moving frame for drawing plants' lines, in milliseconds. At least one plant is always drawn.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__SettlingMsNote: Time per frame for the exact drawing once the camera stops, so a pause in a slow drag never costs a long frame. The refiner waits for it to finish.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__StaleErrorPxNot: A plant less wrong than this, in pixels, waits while the camera moves.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__ZoomErrorPxNote: How many pixels of error count against a plant that has doubled in size on screen since it was drawn: its lines are in the right place, but drawn too coarsely.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__MovingBallSkipP: While the camera moves, a clump or nub under this radius on screen is left out. Masses never are. The exact drawing comes back when it stops.
Vegetation__FrameBudget__Config.Vegetation__FrameBudget__MovingSamplesNo: Coarser line segments, fewer samples round a small ball, and T-junctions found less exactly, while the camera moves.

Vegetation__DevTools__Config.Vegetation__DevTools__Description: The Dev section and the placing tools.
Vegetation__DevTools__Config.Vegetation__DevTools__WarnAbovePlopsNote: Every plop is in the project's file, and other apps read that file. Past this the Dev section says so.
Vegetation__DevTools__Config.Vegetation__DevTools__MaxPlaceSlopeDegNo: A single plant dropped from the browser lands only on what faces up at least this much, so a click on a wall says so instead of planting a bush sideways.
Vegetation__DevTools__Config.Vegetation__DevTools__RightClickSlopPxNo: A right press that travelled further was a pan, so it opens no menu.

Vegetation__Generators__Config.Vegetation__Generators__Description: What can build a plant, by name and version. A saved seed must draw the same bush for ever, so a generator is never edited once a project can hold its plants: a new look is a new version, and the old one stays. The build util refuses an asset naming one not listed here.

Vegetation__Generators__List.Generator__Note: Masses, clumps and nubs, each a ball with a chain of arcs for an outline, and strap leaves. Na__Vegetation__BushBuilder__.js
Small even clumps on the faces of a box, a ball or a cone, for a managed plant: the same line language on a clipped outline. Asset__Form says which. Na__Vegetation__BushBuilder__.js
